evidence.detail: Target commit matches repository HEAD exactly; git status showed no changes.
ROADMAP.md exists and identifies v4 as the unapproved roadmap-review candidate.
The governance validator could not execute because the read-only environment offered no writable temporary directory.
The full unit suite could not complete because socket creation/binding is prohibited; 22 server integration tests errored for that environmental reason.
A separate compile attempt could not create __pycache__ in the read-only checkout.
The roadmap sequences five M2 issues after M1 and binds implementation to prior brief/risk decisions, fresh issue reviews, milestone reviews, and exact human approval.

evidence: AGENTS.md requires independently run checks and requires BLOCKED when non-security evidence cannot be verified.
The governance validator failed before validation because tempfile could not find a writable directory.
The full unit suite reached its server tests but 22 tests errored because the sandbox prohibited loopback socket binding.
The compile check could not write bytecode cache files in the read-only checkout.
findings.remediation: Re-run the roadmap review in a read-only candidate checkout that nevertheless provides a writable temporary/cache directory and permits loopback test sockets; run the validator, full unit suite, and compile check without modifying the candidate tree.
findings.title: Required baseline verification cannot be completed in this review environment
findings.verification: Record exit status 0 and relevant output for `python3 scripts/validate_repo.py`, `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`, and a compile check configured to write caches outside the candidate checkout.

evidence: ISSUE-0008 tests silent renewal only at the AuthManager layer.
ISSUE-0009 requires `/api/policies` and `/api/analysis` to work after app-only sign-in, but does not require either endpoint to be tested after token expiry.
Current server endpoints obtain credentials exclusively through `AUTH.get_token()`, so the integration between expiry-triggered renewal and Graph requests is a distinct failure boundary.
The milestone outcome promises silent renewal for the app-only session.
findings.remediation: Add to ISSUE-0009 the smallest end-to-end mocked server tests showing that an expired app-only token causes silent renewal and then allows both `/api/policies` and `/api/analysis` to complete, plus a stable non-secret response when renewal fails.
findings.title: Endpoint acceptance does not verify the promised expiry-renewal path
findings.verification: With mocked identity and Graph transports and a simulated expired token, verify one successful renewal feeds the new token to each Graph endpoint; also verify provider/network renewal failures produce documented status/error labels with no secret or stack disclosure.

evidence: The tracked-file verification text says `validate_repo.py` helps cover secret-shaped content.
Inspection found no secret, credential, entropy, or known-secret scanning logic in `scripts/validate_repo.py`; its tracked-file logic checks repository cleanliness instead.
The roadmap separately and correctly requires reviewer inspection and prohibits real credentials in agent tasks.
findings.remediation: Clarify that `validate_repo.py` checks governance/cleanliness rather than detecting secrets, and describe tracked-file credential hygiene as a process prohibition plus explicit per-diff reviewer inspection. Do not claim that arbitrary real secrets can be conclusively detected offline.
findings.title: Tracked-file secret-check description overstates validator coverage
findings.verification: Inspect `ROADMAP.md` and `scripts/validate_repo.py` together and confirm each claimed control corresponds to an implemented check or is explicitly labeled manual/process evidence.

limitations: The checkout is a grafted single-commit view, so the target's parent diff is unavailable; review used the complete target records and current source tree.
No live Microsoft authentication or Graph request was attempted because it is a protected action and explicitly outside plan-review evidence.
Execution failures arose from sandbox restrictions rather than observed product failures, but repository rules still require a BLOCKED outcome when required evidence cannot be verified.
review.summary: Target identity and roadmap binding are valid, and the M2 sequence is generally coherent. The review is blocked because required baseline checks cannot run in this read-only, socket-restricted environment. One roadmap change is also required: verify silent renewal through the actual policy and analysis endpoints, not only inside AuthManager.
